findings.summary: Dispatch metadata mismatch, not a product defect: the committed implement handoff records work_head_commit f9305400a0758498fac87236bf072e5b04d8e502, while this review brief labels bcc6d0d033467c000c43bef8fc794af699068715 as work_head_commit. bcc6d0d is the implement materialization commit stacked on that product head, so the two labels name different commits in the same chain; the product content reviewed is unaffected.

Scope disclosure on verification method: this reviewer has only file-inspection tools and no shell or Git access, so the prescribed mechanical `git diff --exit-code bcc6d0d 832bbe05 -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'` was not executed. Product consistency was instead established by reading the worktree tree at HEAD against the approved spec, and no product file shows review-stage contamination; the deterministic seal remains the independent HEAD check.
